error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device at this address. Please check that the IP or hostname is correct and current (it can change if your router assigns it via DHCP), the device is powered on, and Home Assistant is on the same network. The exact reason is recorded in Settings > System > Logs.
error.invalid_host: Please enter a valid IP address or hostname for your device.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the connection as unauthorised. Make sure the device is paired to your account in the 21energy app, then try again.
error.outdated: This device's firmware is missing an expected endpoint and is likely out of date. Please wait a few days for it to update itself. If it doesn't resolve, contact 21energy support.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again. If it keeps happening, check Settings > System > Logs and contact 21energy support.
error.unpaired: This device is not paired yet. Please pair it first using the 21energy app on your phone, then try again.
error.wrong_device_type: The device at this address is not the selected type. Check that you chose the correct device type (Heater/Ofen or Port) and entered the right address.
